title: ICC Cricket Mobile
meta_description: The official ICC cricket game. Don’t just watch, win too!
full_description: Welcome to ICC Cricket Mobile, ICC’s Official Cricket Game - the new cricket game of the year by Star Sports and  nCore, the developers of FAU-G.• Enthralling cricketing experience as real as it can get.• Listen to your favourite celebrity commentator - Ian Bishop, Jatin Sapru, and more coming soon.• Select your country, and compete against the top ICC cricket nations. • Choose from a variety of International Stadiums, different pitch types and daytimes.• Get hands-on with new and different challenges as you progress through the game.• Choose your team and play the biggest rivalry matches, the baap of all rivalries - India vs Pakistan! #GreatestRivalry! #MaukaMauka! ICC Cricket World Cup sirf dekho nahi, jeeto bhi!Experience real life cricket in its purest form - batting, bowling and fielding on mobile with the high quality graphics and motion capture. Captain your favourite ICC team and test your favourite cricketers on the field. Bout against other teams, design strategy in real time and ascend to the top.  Watch replays of the best moments of the match with dynamic camera angles. Experience the best moments from Cricketing Events that have happened so far and future events.Game Modes:• Quick Match - Play and refresh yourself with 2, 5 and 10 over matches, even when you are on a go. On your request, we have added 20 and 50 overs if you love longer gameplays. • Tournament - Play against different countries to ace the league with different ICC tournaments. You can now play the Official ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2022 too!• ICC Vault: Season based challenges where iconic match situations will be simulated and you will have to complete specific targets to win.• Turning Point: One of the key USPs of the game - previous day game’s specific scenario will be handpicked and simulated including ball line, length etc.• Match of the day: Upcoming key matches of the day for users to engage and earn more coins as rewards.• World Rivals: A career mode for you to undergo the necessary drills to improve your strategy and skills. Complete the challenges and win rewards! Exclusive features:• Live Stadiums - Explore the cricketing saga by playing in Mumbai, Ahmedabad, London, Sydney and many more stadiums.• Renowned commentators - Engaging, live, on-field commentary from Ian Bishop and Jatin Sapru. Choose from English and Hindi for now. Tell us what other languages you want us to add next.• 16 International teams reflecting real-world player performance.• Realistic Actions - Motion-captured animations of Batting, Bowling and Fielding. We keep improving the actions and adding new clips with new updates.• Cinematic Cutscenes - Immersive experience with broadcast-like camera views.• Dynamic Gameplay - Optimized for your skill and mobile handset.
